verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents an Explore mode for read-only codebase questions and a built-in Explore subagent, so the agent can investigate the codebase itself. However, the evidence never shows it mapping or explaining an entire unfamiliar codebase autonomously. The only file-context mechanism documented is manual `@` file attachment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-repo mapping/indexing or architecture explanation, evidence that context is gathered automatically without file selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: Switch to Explore mode for read-only codebase questions with minimal latency.
